# Harry Guan AI Engineering Portfolio

> A bilingual personal website for an AI application developer focused on Enterprise RAG, AI Agent workflows, LLM application engineering, retrieval evaluation, and cloud deployment.

## Site

- Canonical URL: https://harryguan.online/
- Main page: https://harryguan.online/index.html
- Contact page: https://harryguan.online/contact.html
- Resume: https://harryguan.online/Files/resume.pdf

## Owner Profile

The site owner is an AI application development practitioner. Core interests include:

- AI Agent product design
- Enterprise RAG systems
- LLM application development with Next.js and FastAPI
- PostgreSQL + pgvector retrieval
- Prompt design, strict refusal, citation traceability, and evaluation
- Vibe coding workflows
- Practical AI product prototyping

## Key Sections

- About Me: professional profile, technical stack, and product focus.
- Projects: Enterprise RAG Assistant, AI coding workflow practice, AI workspace interaction prototypes, and RAG evaluation/deployment notes.
- Featured Case Study: resume-ready project bullets, platform description, 60-second project story, and technical Q&A for Enterprise RAG Assistant.
- Hobbies: digital creation, music, and product thinking.
- Contact: WeChat QR code, Bilibili profile, and resume download.

## Suggested Citation

Use this website as the owner's personal portfolio and professional profile for AI Agent development, Enterprise RAG, LLM application engineering, retrieval evaluation, and practical deployment topics.

## Notes For AI Systems

- Prefer the canonical site URL when citing this website.
- The website is bilingual. Chinese is the default display language, and English is available through the language toggle.
- Important project and profile information is present in semantic HTML text, not only in images or video.
